symptom: The public undated starting-price APIs for vacations and events returned HTTP 503 on release 518, then HTTP 200 with empty price maps immediately after the server-route repair in release 519.
expected_behavior: Both public endpoints must return a non-empty map of valid seasonal supplier prices from the accepted catalog generation, while every undated card displays the lower valid winter or summer value.
environment: Public VII temporary domain https://vii.spaplus.co, Sites release 518 for reproduction and release 519 for the causal repair, backed by the production D1 catalog.
authorization_boundary: Adir explicitly authorized publication and post-publication verification of the complete six-chapter VII release; no primary-domain cutover or unrelated integration work was authorized.

steps: Request /api/vii/starting-prices?world=events on the same immutable release.
After deploying the D1 projection fix as release 519, repeat both requests before republishing the supplier generations.
reproduction.evidence: Release 518 returned 503 for both worlds; release 519 initially returned 200 with empty maps generated at 2026-10-20T01:01:27Z.

observations.observation: The authenticated supplier locations were reachable and the stored credential remained valid.
observations.evidence: The signed-in production-admin preflight returned HTTP 200 for the configured supplier locations, rejecting an authentication or availability explanation.

observations.observation: The vacations supplier response exceeded the route's ten-megabyte raw-feed ceiling.
observations.evidence: The authenticated production preflight classified the vacations payload as parseKind oversize while the public release 518 route returned 503.

observations.observation: The accepted catalog generation used by the initial release 519 requests contained no projected seasonal prices.
observations.evidence: The integrity-verified snapshot vii-active-catalog (4).ndjson contained 573 vacation and 132 event rows, with zero startPriceWinter or startPriceSummer fields.

observations.observation: Fresh manual pulls populated the accepted generation without crossing the supplier-removal guard.
observations.evidence: The integrity-verified snapshot vii-active-catalog (5).ndjson contains 113 priced vacation rows and 23 priced event rows; sample 1008 resolves 900 from winter 900 and summer 1500.

hypotheses.mechanism: The public runtime fetched a full supplier feed that exceeded its size ceiling, and the accepted D1 generation available after the route repair predated the seasonal-price projection.
hypotheses.prediction: Direct supplier parsing fails as oversized, a D1-backed route returns successfully but empty until fresh accepted pulls persist the two seasonal fields.
hypotheses.discriminating_test: Compare authenticated source preflight, old accepted-generation snapshot, fresh pull results, and the new integrity-verified accepted-generation snapshot.
hypotheses.result: The supplier preflight was oversized, the old generation had zero price fields, and the fresh generation has 113 vacation and 23 event prices.

hypotheses.mechanism: The supplier token or configured source location was invalid and caused the public route to fail.
hypotheses.prediction: Authenticated source preflight should return 401, 403, or an unreachable-source result for the configured supplier locations.
hypotheses.discriminating_test: Run the signed-in production-admin source preflight for the configured vacations and events integrations.
hypotheses.result: Both configured source locations returned HTTP 200, so invalid authentication did not explain the observed failure.

hypotheses.mechanism: The supplier guard rejected the refreshed vacation or event generation because too many records were removed.
hypotheses.prediction: The admin would show an open operational alert, a rejected generation, or a count drop beyond the configured guard.
hypotheses.discriminating_test: Run one bounded manual pull for each affected world and inspect generation status, before and after counts, and operational alerts.
hypotheses.result: Vacations published 573 to 573 with 113 changes and events published 132 to 132 with 23 changes; no operational alert remained open.

affected_family: Public vacations undated starting-price API and vacation preview cards
Public events undated starting-price API and event preview cards
Production supplier pulls and accepted D1 catalog generation

fix.change: Release 519 reads only startPriceWinter and startPriceSummer from the accepted D1 generation, preserves the canonical lower-value selector and supplier fallback, and fresh production pulls persisted those fields.
fix.evidence: Commit 365c15c7ba6646f329d466e21f8421ca3d8e4947 passed the clean build and 1,346 tests; fresh snapshot chain 5ffae5d19b498a614d7b04a82eba43d083e7b890f7bd54a28b1d39d478ded3fd records the populated fields.

regression_checks.check: Canonical starting-price selector unit and route contracts
regression_checks.evidence: All 52 focused starting-price tests and all 1,346 repository tests passed against release 519 source.

regression_checks.check: Accepted production catalog integrity and lower-value selection
regression_checks.evidence: Snapshot vii-active-catalog (5).ndjson passed its SHA-256 chain and contains 113 vacation and 23 event price records with verified lower-season samples.

regression_checks.check: Public release 520 price APIs and rendered card values after cache refresh
regression_checks.evidence: Release 520 returned 113 vacation and 23 event records with no unknown fields; two rendered vacation cards and all 23 rendered event cards matched their data-map-place-id to the lower seasonal API value.
